_comment: This file (bm_constants.py) contains only module-level constants: _AVAILABLE_BENCHMARK_TESTS (list of benchmark test names) and _INTERESTING (tuple of metric names). No callable functions, classes, or methods exist. No actionable use cases.
review_AVAILABLE_BENCHMARK_TESTS: review the list of available benchmark test names defined in bm_constants
review_INTERESTING: review the tuple of interesting metric names defined in bm_constants
summarize_bm_constants: summarize the configurable constants for the bm_*.py benchmark family
refactor_bm_constants: refactor bm_constants to add or remove benchmark test names or metrics
test_bm_constants: test that bm_constants exports the expected benchmark test and metric lists
